claims: Ronda Rousey is returning to MMA after a nine-year hiatus.
Ronda Rousey will fight Gina Carano on May 16, 2026.
Ronda Rousey vs. Gina Carano will headline Netflix’s first-ever live MMA event.
The event is at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles.
Ronda Rousey vs. Gina Carano is a 145-pound superfight.
Ronda Rousey vs. Gina Carano is promoted by Most Valuable Promotions.
Ronda Rousey vs. Gina Carano competes directly against UFC Vegas 117.
Gina Carano is returning for her first fight since 2009.
The venue is Intuit Dome, Inglewood, California.
The fight will be live on Netflix.
Ronda Rousey's fight against Gina Carano is her first since losing to Amanda Nunes in 2016.
Ronda Rousey lost to Amanda Nunes in 2016.
Ronda Rousey's loss to Amanda Nunes in 2016 ended her 12-2 MMA career.
